project_overview: A system for managing police cases with features for registration, investigation, prosecution, and search, along with robust audit and access control mechanisms.

constraints.description: Provide detailed context-sensitive help material for all UI actions
constraints.source_text: The solution should provide detailed context-sensitive help material for all the possible actions and scenarios on all user interfaces in the application.

constraints.description: Provide interface for logging and tracking defects/enhancements
constraints.source_text: The solution should provide an interface for the user to log any defects or enhancement requests on the application and track thereafter.

constraints.description: Send alerts to users when actions are taken on alerts
constraints.source_text: The solution should send alerts (e.g., email, SMS) to the user if the user chooses to whenever any action has been taken on the alert.

constraints.description: Maintain unalterable audit trail for critical entities
constraints.source_text: The System must keep an unalterable audit trail capable of automatically capturing and storing information about:The word 'unalterable' is to mean that the audit trail data cannot be modified in any way or deleted by any user; it may be subject to re-department and copying to removable media if required, so long as its contents remain unchanged.

constraints.description: Automatically track events and store audit trail information
constraints.source_text: Once the audit trail functionality has been activated, the System must track events without manual intervention, and store in the audit trail information about them.

constraints.description: Maintain audit trail for at least the life of the related case
constraints.source_text: The System must maintain the audit trail for as long as required, which will be at least for the life of the case to which it refers.

constraints.description: Ensure audit trail data is available for inspection on request
constraints.source_text: The System must ensure that audit trail data is available for inspection on request, so that a specific event can be identified and all related data made accessible, and that this can be achieved by authorised external personnel who have little or no familiarity with the system.

constraints.description: Export audit trails for specified cases
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to export audit trails for specified cases (without affecting the audit trail stored by the System). This functionality can be used by external auditors who wish to examine or analyse system activity.

constraints.description: Capture and store access control violations
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to capture and store violations (i.e. A user's attempts to access a case to which he is denied access), and (where violations can validly be attempted) attempted violations, of access control mechanisms.

constraints.description: Allow limiting case access to specified users/groups
constraints.source_text: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

constraints.description: Provide role-based control for system functionality
constraints.source_text: The system should provide for role-based control for the functionality within the system

constraints.description: Allow users to be members of multiple groups
constraints.source_text: The System must allow a user to be a member of more than one group.

constraints.description: Only admin-users can set up user profiles and allocate users to groups
constraints.source_text: The System must allow only admin-users to set up user profiles and allocate users to groups.

constraints.description: Only super-user can change security attributes
constraints.source_text: The System must allow changes to security attributes for groups or users (such as access rights, security level, privileges, password allocation and management) to be made only by super-user.

constraints.description: Provide configurable responses for unauthorized case access attempts
constraints.source_text: If a user requests access to, or searches for, a case which he does not have the right to access, the System must provide one of the following responses (selectable at configuration time):These options are presented in order of increasing security. Note that the requirement in the third option (i.e. the most stringent) implies that the System must not include such cases in any count of search results; this level of security is normally appropriate for cases dealing with matters such as national security.

constraints.description: Never include unauthorized records in search results
constraints.source_text: If a user performs a quick or advanced search, the System must never include in the search result list any record which the user does not have the right to access.

constraints.description: Log unauthorized case access attempts to audit trail
constraints.source_text: If the System allows users to make unauthorised attempts to access cases, it must log these in the audit trail.

constraints.description: All error messages must be meaningful
constraints.source_text: All error messages produced by the System must be meaningful, so that they can be appropriately acted upon by the users who are likely to see them. Ideally, each error message will be accompanied by explanatory text and an indication of the action(s) which the user can take in response to the error.

constraints.description: Employ consistent UI rules for common look and feel
constraints.source_text: The System must employ a single set of user interface rules, or a small number of sets to provide a familiar and common look and feel for the application.

constraints.description: Display multiple entities simultaneously
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to display several entities (cases, suspects) simultaneously.

constraints.description: Make interfaces customizable and save configurations in user profile
constraints.source_text: The interfaces must be made customizable or user-configurable to the extent possible. (e.g., the displayed columns in the table, move, resize, modify the appearance). Such configurations must be saved in the user profile.

constraints.description: Ensure UI is suitable for users with special needs
constraints.source_text: The System user interface must be suitable for users with special needs; that is, compatible with specialist software that may be used and with appropriate interface guidelines

constraints.description: Perform simple search within 5-8 seconds, advanced search within 10-15 seconds
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system. In this context, performing a search means returning a result list. It does not include retrieving the records themselves.

constraints.description: Retrieve and display recently accessed cases within 5-8 seconds
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 5-8 seconds the case which has been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for rapid retrieval of frequently-used cases, on the understanding that frequency of use is typically correlated with recent use.

constraints.description: Retrieve and display infrequently accessed cases within 20 seconds
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 20 seconds the case which has not been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for cases where cases used infrequently are stored on slower media than more active records.

constraints.description: System must be scalable for different police station sizes
constraints.source_text: The System be scaleable and must not have any features which would preclude use in small or large police stations, with varying numbers of cases handled.

constraints.description: Support multilingual interface
constraints.source_text: The system should support multilingual interface

constraints.description: Design to prevent operational data loss during failures
constraints.source_text: The system should be designed in manner that operational data is not lost in case of any failure of equipment or communication network.

constraints.description: Use HTTPS as communication protocol
constraints.source_text: The system should use HTTPS as the communication protocol, i.e., HTTP over an encrypted secure socket layer (SSL))

constraints.description: Support selective encryption of stored data
constraints.source_text: The system should support selective encryption of the stored data

constraints.description: Ensure secure data transmission using SSL and 2-way digital signatures
constraints.source_text: The system should ensure secure transmission of data over the network and utilize SSL and 2-way digital signatures

constraints.description: Prevent cross-site scripting
constraints.source_text: Prevent cross-site scripting

constraints.description: Prevent SQL injection
constraints.source_text: Prevent SQL Injection

constraints.description: No hard deletes, only soft tagging for deletion
constraints.source_text: Do not allow hard delete and perform only soft tagging the row for deletion

constraints.description: Use cache for storing frequent data
constraints.source_text: Use of cache for storing frequent data

constraints.description: Fetch search results in batches of 10 or 20
constraints.source_text: The search results should be fetched from the database in batches of 10 or 20 maximum as configured within the application

constraints.description: Fetch only fields needed for display in search
constraints.source_text: The search should fetch only the fields that need to be displayed to the user. Only when the user clicks on a particular record to view its further details should a query be fired to fetch the additional details for this particular record only

constraints.description: Apply database indexes on key search columns
constraints.source_text: Database Indexes should be applied on the key columns used for searching

constraints.description: UI should comply with ISO 9241 standard
constraints.source_text: The user interfaces of the system should comply with Standard ISO 9241.

constraints.description: Application logo available on all pages as home link
constraints.source_text: The application logo to be available on all pages as a link to the home page.

constraints.description: Provide text equivalents for non-text media objects
constraints.source_text: All non-text media objects, such as graphical images or video, should be provided with alternative equivalent textual descriptions and/or with equivalent text-based functionality.

constraints.description: Design navigation to help users understand location and options
constraints.source_text: Navigation should be designed to help users understand where they are, where they have been and where they can go next. General guidance on achieving self-descriptiveness is given in ISO 9241-110.

constraints.description: Show users their location in navigation structure
constraints.source_text: Each presentation segment (page or window) should provide the user with a clear and sufficient indication of where he or she is in the navigation structure and of the current segment position with respect to the overall structure.

constraints.description: Offer alternative access paths for navigation
constraints.source_text: Alternative access paths for navigating to a specific unit of content should be offered to support different navigation strategies.

constraints.description: Minimize navigation steps needed to reach content
constraints.source_text: The number of navigation steps needed to reach a certain piece of content should be minimized as long as different mental models, navigation strategies and tasks of the user are taken into account.

constraints.description: Avoid splash screens unless they provide useful content
constraints.source_text: Splash screens should be avoided unless they provide useful content or feedback about the application state to the user. If a splash screen is used, a navigation option to skip it should be offered.

constraints.description: Avoid opening unnecessary windows
constraints.source_text: Additional windows such as new browser windows or pop-up windows should only be opened if this supports the user's task. Opening new windows can distract, confuse or impede users for a variety of reasons. They can superimpose the primary window, hiding relevant information. They could make it cognitively more difficult to understand the navigation structure with negative effects on both usability and accessibility. They also require additional user actions for closing unwanted windows.

constraints.description: Minimize vertical scrolling, avoid horizontal scrolling
constraints.source_text: Vertical scrolling should be minimized. This may be done by placing important information at the top and providing links to information that is further down the page. Horizontal scrolling should be avoided wherever possible.

constraints.description: Design UI for input device independence
constraints.source_text: User interfaces should be designed to allow activation of controls by a variety of input devices. The ability to choose between different input devices for activating controls such as links, fields and buttons is important both for users who prefer a certain input mode, mobile users and users with disabilities. In general, device independence can be achieved if the functionality is operable via a keyboard.

constraints.description: Design UI to be robust against technology changes
constraints.source_text: Making user interfaces robust: User interfaces should be designed to be as robust as possible in the face of changing technology. This encompasses being able to present content containing newer technologies by older user agents as well as designing content to be usable with future technologies.

constraints.description: Ensure acceptable page opening/download times
constraints.source_text: Application pages should be designed and implemented so that there are acceptable opening times and download times for the expected range of technical contexts of use (e.g. bandwidth between the application and the user). This is particularly important for frequently accessed pages or pages that are important for user navigation and exploration, such as the home page.

constraints.description: Minimize potential user errors and recovery effort
constraints.source_text: Minimizing user errors: Potential user errors as well as the effort needed to recover from errors should be minimized.

constraints.description: Provide clear error messages with resolution actions
constraints.source_text: Providing clear error messages: The content of error messages shown on the pages or special error pages should clearly state the reason why the error occurred and, if possible, actions the user can take to resolve the error. Users expect error messages to be in the same language as the user interface.

constraints.description: Allow users to resize text
constraints.source_text: Making text resizable by the user: Text should be able to be resized by the user, using functions provided by the user agent or other appropriate means i.e. see ISO 9241-171.

constraints.description: Ensure text quality does not impede readability
constraints.source_text: Text quality: The quality of textual content with respect to spelling and grammar should be sufficient so as not to impede readability.

constraints.description: Support fast text skimming with clear links and lists
constraints.source_text: Supporting text skimming: Fast skimming of text should be supported by the provision of clear links, bulleted lists, highlighted keywords, logical headings, and short phrases and sentences.

constraints.description: Clearly distinguish within-page links from other links
constraints.source_text: Distinguishable within-page links: Within-page links should be clearly distinguishable from other links that lead to a different page. EX. Within-page links are shown with dashed rather than solid underlines

constraints.description: Avoid link overload that impedes text readability
constraints.source_text: Avoiding link overload: Text pages containing large proportions of links should be formatted so that the presence of links does not impede the readability of the text.

constraints.description: Use familiar terminology for navigation links
constraints.source_text: Using familiar terminology for navigation links: Navigation links — particularly links representing the main navigation structure — should be labelled with terms that are familiar to the user, based on his/her general knowledge, prior experience in the application domain or experience of using other systems.

constraints.description: Use descriptive link labels indicating target/purpose
constraints.source_text: Using descriptive link labels: The target or purpose of a link should be directly indicated by its label, avoiding generic labels such as 'go' or 'click here' except where the purpose of the link is clear from its context on the page or the labels have commonly understood semantics in the particular application domain. Using appropriate terminology specific to the user's tasks and information needs is important for making the content easy to understand.

constraints.description: Clearly mark links that open new windows
constraints.source_text: Marking links opening new windows: Links that open new browser windows or pop-up windows should be clearly marked.

constraints.description: Clearly distinguish navigation links from action controls
constraints.source_text: Distinguishing navigation links from controls: Navigation links should be clearly distinguishable from controls activating some action. Typical action types in user interfaces include manipulating application data, performing searches, communication actions, such as opening a new e-mail window or starting a chat function, and presentation-related actions, such as sorting a list of search results.

constraints.description: Provide printable versions for long documents
constraints.source_text: Providing printable document versions: If a document is either too long, dispersed over several pages or in a specific layout that is not suitable for online reading, a printer-friendly version of the document should be provided that prints the content in a form acceptable to the user (e.g. in the expected layout, paper format, or orientation).

constraints.description: Use white space carefully to not impair visual skimming
constraints.source_text: Use of 'white space': 'White space' on a page i.e. space filled only with the background color should be used in such a way that it does not impair the visual skimming of the page. While white space is an important means of visually organizing the different content elements on a page, if the distance between the blocks of information displayed becomes too large, rapid skimming of the page can be impeded.

constraints.description: Select appropriate page lengths based on purpose
constraints.source_text: Selecting appropriate page lengths The length of a page should be selected so as to support the primary purpose and use of the page. Short pages are generally more appropriate for homepages, navigation pages, or overview pages that need to be read quickly. Longer pages can be more appropriate when users want to read the content without interruptions or when the page needs to match a paper counterpart.

constraints.description: Use color carefully, not as sole information means
constraints.source_text: Using colour: Colour should be used with care, taking into account human capabilities and restrictions in perceiving colour, and not as the only means of conveying information. Color should never be the only means of coding. Some users may have difficulties in perceiving certain colors or color combinations (color-blindness).

constraints.description: Use frames carefully with alternatives
constraints.source_text: Using frames with care: If frames are used, care should be taken to avoid possible problems, for example, those involving the use of the back button, bookmarking of pages, or scrolling of information. When frames are used, it is important to title each frame, and to describe its purpose and how frames relate to one another other. Providing alternatives to frame-based presentation: If frames are used, an alternative way of presenting relevant information without frames should be provided. Providing alternative text-only pages: When style sheets and/or frames are turned off it should be possible for the user to read and understand the page; alternatively, the user should be provided with an equivalent alternative text-only page.

constraints.description: Use consistent layout schemes across pages
constraints.source_text: Consistent page layout: Pages should be designed using consistent layout schemes, supporting the user in finding similar information at the same position on different pages. Overall layout schemes apply to all pages and are preferable when all pages have a similar structure. Frequently, however, different pages have different purposes and types of content. In such cases, pages can usually be grouped in different categories, using one layout scheme for each category consistently.

constraints.description: Place title information consistently across pages
constraints.source_text: Placing title information consistently: Page titles should be placed in a consistent location on the different pages.

constraints.description: Consider principles of human perception in UI design
constraints.source_text: Observing principles of human perception When designing application pages, the general principles of human perception should be taken into account. The International Standards mentioned below shall be consulted for guidance. Practical guidelines for presenting information to the user are to be found in ISO 9241-12. Guidance on selecting and using different forms of interaction techniques is to be found in ISO 9241-14 to ISO 9241-17. ISO 9241-14 gives guidance about menus, ISO 9241-15 about command dialogues, ISO 9241-16 about direct manipulation and ISO 9241-17 about forms. In addition, when designing multimedia information presentations, the design principles and recommendations described in ISO 14915-1 to ISO 14915-3 should be taken into account. Appropriate content presentation also plays a key role in accessibility.

constraints.description: Include link to home/landmark page on each page
constraints.source_text: Linking back to the home page or landmark pages: Each page should contain a link leading to the home page of the application or to a landmark page that is easy to recognize for the user.

constraints.description: Provide site map showing application structure
constraints.source_text: Providing a site map: A separate navigation overview such as a site map should be provided for application showing the structure of the site in an overview form.

constraints.description: Maintain consistency between navigation components and content
constraints.source_text: Consistency between navigation components and content: If navigation components (or overviews) are shown in conjunction with associated content, consistency between the navigation component and the content shown should be maintained by indicating in the navigation component (e.g. highlighting) the topic currently visible in the content area.

constraints.description: Place navigation components consistently
constraints.source_text: Placing navigation components consistently: Navigation components should be placed consistently on the pages or in the framesets in the pages of the application.

constraints.description: Make individualization/adaptation evident to users
constraints.source_text: Making individualization and adaptation evident: It should be made evident to the user when individualization and/or adaptation are used.

constraints.description: Make current user profile evident when used
constraints.source_text: Making user profiles evident: If predefined user profiles or user-specified profiles are used for individualizing or adapting content, the profile currently used should be made evident. If profiles are used, it is important to provide users with information about this concept and its implications.

constraints.description: Allow users to see, modify and delete their profiles
constraints.source_text: Allowing users to see and change profiles: If user-specified profiles are used, users should be able to see, modify and delete that profile on demand.

constraints.description: Follow usability.gov guidelines for UI
constraints.source_text: The user interfaces of the system should follow the guidelines specified under www.usability.gov

constraints.description: System must be available during specified times
constraints.source_text: from <xx:00> to <xx:00>; on <all weekdays/xxx days per year>. The System must be available to users:

constraints.description: Planned downtime must not exceed specified hours
constraints.source_text: The planned downtime for the System must not exceed <xx> hours per <rolling three month period>. The System is considered to be down if any user is unable to perform any normal System function and if this failure is attributed to any component of the System other than the workstation.

constraints.description: Unplanned downtime must not exceed specified duration
constraints.source_text: Unplanned downtime for the System must not exceed <xx hours/minutes> per <rolling three month period>.

constraints.description: Number of unplanned downtime incidents must not exceed limit
constraints.source_text: The number of incidents of unplanned downtime for the System must not exceed <x> per <rolling three month period>.

constraints.description: System must be restorable within specified time after failure
constraints.source_text: In the event of any software or hardware failure, it must be possible to restore the System (with inline synchronization) within no more than <xx> hours.

constraints.description: Provide adequate response times for common functions
constraints.source_text: The System must provide adequate response times for commonly performed functions under both standard and peak conditions

constraints.description: Design for satisfactory performance in low-bandwidth stations
constraints.source_text: The system should be designed to have satisfactory performance even in Police Stations connected on low-bandwidth

constraints.description: Implement using Service Oriented Architecture (SOA)
constraints.source_text: The system should be implemented using Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) and have a modular design

constraints.description: Develop on Open Standards
constraints.source_text: The system should be developed on Open Standards

constraints.description: Build on common User Access and Authentication Service
constraints.source_text: The system should be built on a common User Access and Authentication Service to ensure Single-Sign on for the end-user

constraints.description: Design for centralized deployment and maintenance
constraints.source_text: The system should be developed for a centralized deployment and maintenance

constraints.description: Develop for deployment in 3-tier datacenter architecture
constraints.source_text: The system should be developed to be deployed in a 3-tier datacenter architecture

constraints.description: Design with n-tier architecture separating presentation, business, and data logic
constraints.source_text: The system should be designed to have a n-tier architecture with the presentation logic separated from the business logic that is again separated from the data-access logic

constraints.description: Extensible to provide access through PDAs and mobile data terminals
constraints.source_text: The system should be extensible to provide access to the interfaces through PDA's and mobile data terminals

constraints.description: Adopt standardized formats and common metadata elements
constraints.source_text: The system should adopt standardized formats and common metadata elements

constraints.description: Design for browser-based access with minimal client requirements
constraints.source_text: The system should be designed for access through browser-based systems and must impose minimal requirements on the client device

constraints.description: Support multiple types of remote access communication services
constraints.source_text: The system must support multiple types of communication services for remote access

constraints.description: Support public access to subset of data and functionality
constraints.source_text: The system should have capability to support public access to a subset of data and functionality

constraints.description: Support multi-tier authentication where required
constraints.source_text: The system should support multi-tier authentication where required

constraints.description: Support SSL encrypted connections
constraints.source_text: The system should support SSL encrypted connections

constraints.description: Support secure virtual private network connections
constraints.source_text: The system should support secure virtual private network connections

constraints.description: Run on multiple browsers
constraints.source_text: The system should run on multiple browsers

constraints.description: Use AJAX to improve user experience
constraints.source_text: Use of AJAX based technology to improve user experience.

constraints.description: Consider aggressive page loading based on screen and usage pattern
constraints.source_text: Aggressive page loading to be considered based on the screen and estimate usage pattern

constraints.description: Leverage asynchronous HTTP socket capabilities for scalability
constraints.source_text: Leverage Asynchronous HTTP socket capabilities of web server for scalability and performance

constraints.description: Host all static content on web server
constraints.source_text: Host all the static content (documents, images) on the web server

constraints.description: Display records in batches/paged manner
constraints.source_text: Display of records on the screen in batches/paged manner

constraints.description: Configure hierarchical cache for frequently used searches
constraints.source_text: A hierarchical cache should be configured and used for caching of results of most frequently used searches
